Spotlight: Dual C&D winner who had a near-miss at Wetherby (5.5f) last month but she failed to beat a rival at Hamilton last time; handles most ground but has a bit to prove again after that last run and others are more solid.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Get Extra Places On Selected Races' Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-race maiden who was runner-up here (6f, good to firm) last Monday but this is a deeper race and she needs to find more on this drop back in trip; yard also runs Wee Mary and Doon The Glen.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Get Extra Places On Selected Races' Handicap
Spotlight: Four of his eight wins have been at Ayr including three over C&D; his last success was 12 months ago but he's been placed in two of his last four runs and has each-claims again.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Again below market expectations last time in first-time cheekpieces (headgear off today); been running in better company, ran well in a Tapeta handicap last summer and it's too soon to write him off down another 2lb.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Things didn't pan out his way when among the favourites for a Kempton handicap early in the month, back from a break; better than that and is 1-1 on Tapeta having won here last summer; one to consider.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Seven-time AW winner who has four wins and a second to his name in five starts in 7f Tapeta handicaps; the drop back from 1m and switch from turf both look in his favour off his last winning mark.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Missed more than three years after a few starts for Charlie Appleby; started 100-1 for his new yard, having been gelded, at Newbury last month, when well held after racing freely; likely best watched unless there's good money around.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Found a weak Newcastle novice last backend and has struggled in two runs back, latterly when out of his depth in a Group 3; first-time headgear will need to make a big difference.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Runs over shy of 1m for the first time in ages (may well help) on her Tapeta debut; shown enough in three runs for her current, in-form yard to suggest this mark is well within reach; shortlisted.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Dry since a C&D win for the Quinn yard more than two years ago; now 10lb lower than when last seen on the AW (3-8 here) but has regressed on turf in the meantime and may just be on the downgrade.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Run exclusively in sprints since handicapping, latterly over 5f; finished last in two runs back this season and has plenty to prove, including stamina.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won six 7f Tapeta handicaps in the opening months of last year, two over C&D, going two stone up the weights; didn't see out 1m when last seen and holds each-way claims back on his favoured surface.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Short prices for three sprint novices/maidens thus far, getting off the mark when coming away with a subsequent winner last month; unexposed as he enters handicap company and remains open to improvement.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Taken out of her intended handicap debut early in the month (1m) on account of good to firm ground, having won her maiden on soft seven weeks ago; hard to know the worth of that (400-1 shot second; none of the front four run since) but she's unexposed.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won his maiden here last autumn (1m); tumbled down the weights this year and the return to Tapeta, minus the cheekpieces this time, could well bring about improvement; interesting to see how he goes in the market.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a minor event on the Flat at Roscommon last year; much stronger form when second in a 1m4f Listed race at Leopardstown; has not looked a natural over jumps, but managed a maiden hurdle win at Cork in May; below par in a Listed race at Limerick last time, much better at the Curragh previously.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran in two bumpers; not a big price when finishing with only one behind him at Leopardstown in March; contested a strong event at the Punchestown festival; switch to hurdling did the trick when won a 2m3f maiden at Kilbeggan; promising but this looks too demanding.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: AQPS winner; joined Willie Mullins; Punchestown second in February was quite promising; soundly beaten in the Fred Winter; costly failure at Cork; left Mullins to join Gordon Elliott; took advantage of a 10lb concession when much too strong for his former stablemate Beauvallon (odds-on) at Bellewstown; penalty makes this a much tougher task.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Rated 86 on the Flat, won a 1m4f Cork maiden on soft-to-heavy in May; made a bright start over hurdles when trouncing penalised winners from the Elliott and Mullins stables in a 2m3f conditions event at Kilbeggan six weeks ago; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
OwnerName: Ms P Twiss & J Twiss & M O'Sullivan & S Nevin Twiss
Spotlight: Flat maiden; placed on all six starts over hurdles; beaten favourite in a maiden at Killarney; likely to find this opposition too demanding; stablemate Munsif is rated 4lb higher.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed a good attitude when making a winning debut at Roscommon three weeks ago; promising sort, but this rise in class may come too soon.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Won three of his six races (at up to 1m4f) for Roger Varian; 0-6 over hurdles; has failed to build on a third-placing in a Naas event in which the top-class Saratoga was second; twice a beaten favourite since then (including in a 4yo handicap at Ascot) and looks vulnerable.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2024; hurdling credentials are weak; unplaced in three Flat handicaps this month.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to three winners; dam a half-sister to brilliant staying hurdler Big Buck's; ran twice on the Flat in France last autumn; jumped tidily and won readily on introduction to hurdling at Ballinrobe in May; stable has won this in three of the last five seasons, and seven of the last 12.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed ability on sole start on the Flat in Germany (1m2f, soft) last October; made a satisfactory introduction to hurdling when third in a maiden at Roscommon in May; well held in third behind Mino Des Mottes at Bellewstown; can win a maiden but faces a tough task here.

RaceName: Galmont Hotel & The Galway Bay Hotel Novice Hurdle
Spotlight: Unplaced in maidens at Clonmel and Sligo; no apparent chance against previous winners.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 5f win at Wolverhampton and posted a good second at Bath (5.5f) in April; off since a below-par fifth there (5.5f) in May but she has won when fresh.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Cheekpieces on for first time when doubling his tally with 5f success at Ffos Las in June but only fifth of seven in retained headgear over C&D since.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: On a long losing run but she arrives in decent nick, ridden too aggressively when seventh of 12 over 6f here two weeks ago; this C&D winner is not out of things.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: R M Brilley, A E Townsend & Partner
Spotlight: Kept busy through the winter (won over 5f at Wolverhampton) but holding his form well, challenging wide when fifth of 11 in 5f Chester handicap nine days ago; considered.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Chelmsford (5f) in January and placed for the fifth time since when runner-up in 5.5f Bath handicap 12 days ago; also took this in 2025 so he's a likely player.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 5f winner last summer; gelded and right back on song after 11 weeks off with head second of four in 5f Yarmouth handicap 12 days ago, doing especially well given he was very slowly away after blindfold removed late; big shout nudged up 2lb.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a fourth AW success of 2026 at Wolverhampton (6f) in May; she's yet to show that form on turf though, just seventh of ten at Goodwood (6f) last time.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to her three 6f AW wins last backend but she's in good form, third of five at Ffos Las (5f) last time; in the mix once more.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo; in good form without winning in 2025 but has failed to beat a rival in a pair of small-field handicaps at Bath and Chepstow this term; cheekpieces go on for the first time here.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a first win at the third attempt in 5.5f Bath maiden last July; lightly raced since and came in last of seven over C&D 30 days ago; cheekpieces are reached for.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: K Hunter, D Leon And Hunscote Stud Ltd
Spotlight: Is 0-10 and not proving easy to catch right, last of five at Brighton (5f) 20 days ago.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Only modest form shown in her six runs to date for Conrad Allen; failed to see her race out when ninth of ten in 7f Doncaster handicap 24 days ago and drops to 5f for first time for new yard here.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Triple turf winner who made it 2-2 over C&D when bouncing back with a comfortable success (good) three weeks ago; remains feasibly treated off only 3lb higher and he won't mind if the forecast rain arrives; key player.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Triple course winner who made all over 1m at this track last September; has generally struggled since but she showed signs of a revival here (fourth of 12) three weeks ago and is now 6lb lower than for her last success; could be dangerous back up in trip and she's versatile ground-wise.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
OwnerName: A Sinclair, I Jardine & V Renwick
Spotlight: Overall record of 3-54 but he's been placed over hurdles in his last two runs and is well handicapped on his best Flat form in 2025; hard to rule out back in this sphere and he has won at this track.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Record of 2-37 and both wins came over 1m1f (good) last August; has mixed record this season but he had a close call at Pontefract (1m2f) last month and was runner-up behind a big improver over C&D last Monday; on the same mark here and he's respected.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner who was a respectable third at Perth (2m, good) 25 days ago; still lightly raced on the Flat but she's 5lb higher than for her win here (1m5f, soft) last autumn and not sure this drop back to 1m2f will suit; others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Well treated on her best form for Ian Williams but she's failed to beat a rival in both runs for current yard; overall record is now 1-14 and she needs a major revival in new headgear.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
OwnerName: D J Jones & M T Brougham
Spotlight: Returned to form with a comfortable win off a reduced mark at Pontefract (1m, good) 12 days ago; back up 6lb in the weights but that was a personal best last time and he's effective at this trip; shortlisted.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Won a classified event here (1m, good to soft) last July and reached the frame in his next five starts; looks interesting on that form but he lost his way during the winter and has bit to prove after 198 days off.

RaceName: Ladbrokes 'Free Rewards With Instant Spins' Handicap
Spotlight: Now 1lb lower than for his Musselburgh win (1m, good) last September but he hasn't posed a serious threat this season and was well held over C&D last Monday; needs to raise his game.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Useful 7f and 1m form in 2026, including when fifth in a higher grade at Sandown (first-time cheekpieces) in June on yard debut; however he's won just once in the last three years and although he showed useful form in a C&D novice as a 3yo, his AW runs since have come on Polytrack; shade to prove.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Seen much more often on turf than the AW but he did win on sand at Chelmsford (7f) last December and has since shown useful course form over 6f and 7f; down the field at Doncaster most recently but would have a squeak if back to his C&D form in March.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: P C J Dalby & R D Schuster
Spotlight: One win from five handicap runs, when making all over 7f at Haydock last summer; looked capable of finding some improvement when a never-nearer fourth of ten at Epsom (7f) in June on second run back from a layoff, despite not handling the track; acts on Polytrack but unraced on Tapeta.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods
Spotlight: Suited by this surface and his rivals never really got a look in when he made all here three weeks ago, taking his record to 2-2 over C&D; has gone back up 7lb but he's only just above his winning mark on Kempton AW last June and has another good run in him.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won 5f debut as a 2yo before some useful efforts in defeat at that trip, 6f and 7f; his 3yo season for new yard has yet to get off the ground though and he lacks any experience of the AW.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Back from wind surgery with 7f novice win on Polytrack in 2025 and he's well treated on the pick of his later form on turf; probably handles Tapeta but he dropped right out on yard debut at York in June, following nearly a year off the track, and it's no easy matter assessing him today.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Below best on this track in November but he had won in good style over C&D the time before and seemed to appreciate the return to Southwell (7f) last month when he scored by overhauling one who has won both starts since (other subsequent winners behind); major player back up 3lb.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Winner here at 1m who has also been involved in tight finishes over C&D, most recently in January; this will probably take more winning though and he needs more than he's shown on his last two turf starts.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won 6f turf maiden and a 7f handicap on Lingfield AW as 2yo; seemed to improve when runner-up over C&D in January but he hasn't gone on from that back on turf (7f and 1m); return to this trip should suit but others are higher up the list.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Construction Safety Specialists Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Low-key debut in March but did much better when runner-up over C&D next time and has proved consistent in defeat since (in cheekpieces latest, now discarded); switches to this level for the first time (has had a mark for last three runs) but easier handicaps await in the future.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Michael J Mulligan & Patrick G Walsh
Spotlight: Got off the mark on his first start for the stable in a first-time tongue-tie when landing a 2m handicap hurdle at Ballinrobe in May; emerged with plenty of credit when a good runner-up to a useful performer on the Flat at Bellewstown since; plenty of weight but should make his presence felt.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Took a keen hold in defeat in maiden hurdles at Clonmel and Tramore; settled better but still found one too good on his return to Tramore in May; handicap hurdle debut here and respected but there might be one or two better handicapped.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Improved significantly on better ground and reportedly settled better when getting up late to land a Sligo maiden hurdle last month; might benefit from a longer trip but probably still capable of improvement, and the stable has been known to come alive at this meeting.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner; returned from a six month with a very eye-catching effort when a staying-on fourth to Can Happen at Ballinrobe in May; has the hallmarks of one laid out for this and has the services of a decent 7lb claimer; interesting.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained his second win over hurdles when landing a Downpatrick handicap hurdle in May; mid-division but not disgraced in a 1m5f Ballinrobe Flat handicap since; withdrawn twice on good ground so an ease in the ground would most likely enhance his chances.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Consistent efforts in bumpers and maiden hurdles rewarded when readily accounting for today's rival Whats New in a Sligo maiden hurdle last month; up 5lb for that and more needed in his first handicap but looks to be going the right way.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Paid immediate dividends on his first run for the stable when winning a Clonmel handicap hurdle in June and followed up in good style four days later at Sligo; up 16lb in total, but looks to have been prepared with this in mind and his rookie trainer is already showing himself to be a good operator.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Winning hurdler for Joseph O'Brien; took a step forward in his headgear combination when a solid third in a handicap hurdle at Killarney two weeks ago; this is more competitive again but has a squeak if he can improve again.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Beat Whats New in a juvenile maiden hurdle here in October; no impact in conditions races over hurdles since and down the field in a Fairyhouse Flat handicap last time; others preferred on his handicap debut over hurdles.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Got off the mark on his only start for John McConnell in a handicap hurdle at Wexford in March; sold for £29,000 at Goffs UK since and makes his stable debut here; has shown preference for cut in the ground but is clearly of interest.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner two years ago for Liam O'Brien; consistent this year but keeps finding one too good; hold-up horse and likely to need a bit of luck in running; could get into the frame.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner in 2024; some respectable efforts over hurdles but not enough to suggest he can win off this mark; mid-division in a Roscommon Flat maiden last month after seven months off.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Martin Baker & Owen O'Connor & James McCarville
Spotlight: French import has done reasonably well in three maiden hurdle outings; tough ask on his handicap debut and will probably appreciate further, but not dismissed.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Last of three wins for Philip Rothwell came at Downpatrick last summer (2m3f); Clonmel claiming second in May his best recent run; debuts for new yard here.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Admirable veteran gained a fourth turf win on the Flat at Sligo in May; has come up short off revised mark since; first run over hurdles since unseating at Cork in March last year for Sneezy Foster; others more likely.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles for Paul Kiely; ran well despite jumping left on her stable debut at Listowel last month; down the field in a Tramore Flat handicap since; would not be a total surprise if she got involved.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fair form over hurdles in the final months of last season; second in a maiden at Wexford and fourth in a 21-runner handicap at Fairyhouse despite not jumping well; potentially interesting on handicap debut

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: P McCormack & David P McCormack & Sarah Glynn
Spotlight: Winning hurdler and comes here in good form after a convincing success in a 2m handicap chase at Roscommon last month; 9lb lower over flights and a good 5lb claimer booked; makes a compelling case.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 13-race maiden over hurdles; easily held by a couple of these in maiden hurdles; unseated when still with a chance at Ballinrobe last week; Darragh O'Keeffe booked ,but needs to find a bit more to land this.

RaceName: EASYFIX Iggy Daly Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Winner on the Flat and very lightly raced over hurdles by comparison; good run in a 1m handicap at Leopardstown in April, but little in her profile marks her out as a potential winner of this.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Two minor hurdle wins at about 2m, the latest this month off a mark of 100; has something to prove in a maiden but she is bred for the Flat and this is uncompetitive; not ruled out for stable that is going well with Oisin Murphy booked (0-6 for the yard).

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: C Wright, D Kilburn & N Hutchings
Spotlight: Beaten 14l+ in two AW events at 1m (10-1 and 22-1), last November and in April; the step up in trip can suit but handicaps are the logical next step.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Lost her chance at the start on debut at Wolverhampton (about 1m1f, AW) in June and she had blinkers fitted when slightly hampered, but kept on well, behind a fair type at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; major contender for yard in fine form.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Unraced on ground quicker than good, seemingly best at around 1m on Tapeta and good to soft so far; perhaps found soft ground slower than ideal when well held at Ffos Las (1m2f; first-time blinkers, now discarded) in June; has left Ed Walker for 9,500gns since and still has some trip queries.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Big prices and well adrift in two 1m races on Southwell AW in January; some encouragement in pedigree for 1m2f but of more interest when qualified for ordinary handicaps.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Turned over four times at short prices since handicapping and made it three lacklustre efforts on the spin last time (Polytrack); goes back up in trip and has something to prove now.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Again never looked like winning here last time but that was a step back in the right direction and he looked worth a try over this longer trip (half-brother to a useful middle-distance winner); not out of it for a yard also responsible for Baldosa.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: String of ordinary efforts at huge prices, the step up to 1m not helping here last month; no obvious appeal.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Got it together since upped to this trip, again giving her running when favourite behind Harswell River off this mark at Redcar eight days ago; looks set to get involved once more.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Came away with a progressive rival here early in the month (1m4f) off 4lb lower; not as good at Catterick last week but pulled hard and should fare better back round here and dropped back in trip.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Stamina for 1m2f wasn't assured at Redcar, a course that suits her, eight days ago but she was fine and meets Baldosa (third) and Diamond Aura (fourth) on the same terms; below-par favourite here in the spring, which would be a slight worry.

RaceName: Discover Valentina Luxury Photobooth Experience Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Competitive since upped to this trip, latterly behind Harswell River and Baldosa at Redcar eight days ago on her first start for the yard (picked up from Hugo Palmer for 12,000gns); chance of turning things round if settling better.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Wins have all come on good or softer turf and he confirmed his liking for Hamilton when making it 3-5 there early last month; currently 0-6 on the AW (all Tapeta) and a 5lb rise sees him on a career-high mark for a yard that might be in better form.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Lacks consistency now and has become hard to win with; down to a career-low mark but his record here is far from exciting and he's some way down the pecking order.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winner who showed more back on Tapeta last time, when drawn wide and inclined to hang right at Wolverhampton; remains pretty consistent and is on a competitive mark, so there are positives.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time Tapeta winner whose AW mark has eased after three no-shows on turf and who's now 1lb lower than when successful at Newcastle last winter; currently 3-10 for Billy Loughnane and a better showing can be expected.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Found the drop to 5f against him last time (Tapeta), following a slow start, in a Newcastle handicap in which the leaders didn't come back; become very hit and miss but a case could be made dropped 2lb.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Won this race last year off a 3lb lower mark, when the strong pace set things up for him; got into the habit of blowing the start lately and will need the breaks from stall 13 but the return here will help (two wins and two seconds from eight runs over C&D).

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Got her act together since the hood went on and is 1-1 over 6f on Tapeta (off 4lb lower in the spring); no obvious reason why she won't go well again for a trainer who also saddles Cairdeas, and she holds claims in a competitive handicap.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Made it 3-4 on Tapeta when winning off 4lb lower early last month; a poor effort on turf a few weeks ago will need forgiving but he's the type to respond positively to a change of yard and the headgear coming off, so holds possibilities.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Did most racing for two previous yards over further and is still to convince as a sprinter; best effort since undergoing wind surgery on his debut for his current trainer ten days ago, though, in a race that didn't set up ideally; player if they go hard.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Been around a bit in recent times and tried over various trips, often pulling hard; got it together for his current trainer but will need to settle better, with just daylight on his outside from stall 14, back on the AW.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Expensive to follow this season, having missed ten months, for Tim Easterby; run well on Tapeta before and a couple of times in a visor too, so it wouldn't surprise were to to take this in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Only has a 2yo maiden win to his name for William Haggas but has run well several times in handicaps for this yard and remains on a competitive mark; one of the likelier winners.

RaceName: Prestige Safety Services PPE And Workwear Handicap
Spotlight: Done a lot of her racing over 7f, including when winning here off 4lb lower in the spring; again pulled too hard when a beaten-favourite last time and perhaps the drop back to sprinting will help on that front.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Failed to enjoy much luck in running when fifth in a 6f maiden on debut at Fairyhouse; plenty of improvement likely and looks the first string of the Ballydoyle duo, although cheekpieces have been reached for on just his second start.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Last of five and little impact in a 1m maiden at Killarney; Colin Keane booked, but looks a forlorn hope on that evidence.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-brother to winners Poker Face (1m/1m2f inc AW/Group 2; RPR 118) and Star Devine (US 5.5f/6f turf inc stakes; 107); dam 1m2f AW winner (70), half-sister to 1,000 Guineas/Irish Oaks winner Blue Bunting; newcomer with a couple of Group 1 entries; looks the stable second string and likely to improve for this.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: E80,000 Y; sixth foal; brother to 1m-1m3f winner Mylady (inc 2yo/German Group 3/US Grade 3; RPR 114), half-brother to three winners inc Maigret (German 1m/8.5f inc 2yo/dirt/Group 3; 114); unraced dam out of French 11.5f winner; mostly middle-distance pedigree; best watched this time, but should be worth watching.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Chased home a subsequent Group 2 winner on his Curragh debut in June; never got involved in the Windsor Castle (behind Our Boy Bailey) but did take a forward step when  a keeping-on third in a Listed 1m contest at Naas; drops back in trip here, but a prominent ride can be expected and he could be tough to pass.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Solid late work when a close second on debut over this trip at Roscommon in May; ran well in the circumstances (One Number behind) in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot; sure to win a maiden and this could be the day.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Strong-finishing third on debut at Fairyhouse in June; no obvious reason for a lack-lustre display in a Curragh maiden since; National Stakes entry gives an idea of what he might be thought capable of; adds a fair bit of interest to the contest.

RaceName: Eventus Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
Spotlight: Showed some nice promise on debut in a 7f Curragh maiden last month; might just be up against it a little here, though.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Impressively landed 6f Wolverhampton novice on his debut in June; beat only one in 5.5f Bath novice 26 days ago but shouldn't be written off.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has failed to offer much in a pair of 6f novices over C&D this summer; needs to take a big step forward.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 9-2 but very green when a never-dangerous sixth of eight in novice at Yarmouth (6f, good) on his debut in May; gelded since and could improve a fair bit here after a break.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Shaped very well when placed in 6f Newbury maiden and 7f Newmarket novice first two runs; failed to match that when a fading third of six in 7f Salisbury novice last time but is well worth another chance.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Thames Boys, J Henwood & J Clay
Spotlight: Has shown some fair form, runner-up for the third time from four runs in 6f Salisbury novice last month; cheekpieces go on now and he holds good claims.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28-1, last of 12 in novice over C&D (good to firm) on his debut two weeks ago.

RaceName: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hinted at promise on both runs, fading late when eighth of nine in C&D novice two weeks ago; can take a step forward for his in-form yard.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise at a big price on his Chester debut last month and improved on that at the same course last time, when getting over from stall 8 and making all (very rare 2yo winner for the yard); major player under a penalty.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Well held on debut (7f) and again behind Towelontheterrace at Chester last time; nurseries may be his time to shine once handicapped after tonight.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns yearling who's a brother to three winners, notably Dream Of Dreams (Group 1) and Candelisa, and half-brother to a good few more; couple of fancy sales-race entries in the autumn and worth keeping an eye on but his yard isn't noted for 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Trainer won this with a short-priced newcomer last summer (went on to win the Hornblower here); this 20,000euros yearling, £60,000 breeze-up 2yo is bred to be sharp and has landed the rail draw; market useful.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 45,000euros yearling who's the second foal of a (maiden) sister to two useful 2yo winners for the yard in Living In The Past and Jungle Drums (successful on 2yo debut); holds a Two-Year-Old Trophy entry; the market will guide.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ducked sharply right leaving the stalls on her first two starts and was again slowly away last time; finished well beaten on each occasion and can't be recommended.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: 60,000euros yearling, 18,000gns breeze-up 2yo who holds no notable entries; her trainer also saddles Towelontheterrace, who's likely her best chance.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Useful AW winner in France over 1m/1m1f; campaigned mainly over hurdles by current yard; won over 1m4f on soft at Gowran on penultimate start; big burden even with 7lb claimed.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Jessica Harrington/Michael Bell; winner at Group 3 level for his two former trainers; despite reduced mark, does not look well handicapped at this stage; stable debut.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
OwnerName: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited
Spotlight: Dual-purpose mare; only Flat win came in Leopardstown 3yo maiden (1m2f); good form this term in very competitive handicaps, second at Navan, close fourth of 15 in 2m2f Chester Cup, seventh of 20 behind a stablemate in 2m4f Ascot Stakes; most recent run was in a Group race; one of five for the stable.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Smart hurdler, 4-7 on the Flat; down the field behind Westminster Moon at Leopardstown on first outing this season; warmed up for this with an odds-on win at Bellewstown; lends substance to yard's strong challenge.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: In rear in the Ascot Stakes after a moderate run over hurdles; breakthrough win was over 1m4f at last year's festival; showed good form on soft ground in the autumn, winning twice, including over 1m5f.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Showed good form in 2024 with a trio of wins from 1m2f-1m6f; runner-up in three of last four starts last term; fourth to Holy See on seasonal return at Gowran in April (1m4f, soft); another solid display when third over 2m at the Curragh.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Polish and German, placed in 1m2f Group races in 2024; took a while to find his level in Irish handicaps; decisively landed a gamble in a 24-runner handicap at the Curragh (1m6f, good) in May; never threatened in the Ascot Stakes; this trip should be within his range; live each-way chance.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Most recent of his five wins was in a valuable 2m handicap at Naas in October 2024; ran poorly when well fancied for this race last year, others seem more dependable; one of three in the field for his owner, Derek O'Connor rides.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Has run only three times since her 50-1 win in this race in 2024 for this rider, also aboard for an emphatic victory over Smooth Tom in a 1m4f conditions event at the Curragh last October; lack of a prep-run could be a drawback.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: 145-rated staying hurdler; good form in valuable handicaps at Aintree and Haydock in the spring; claimer-ridden when winning a 1m6f maiden at Killarney 13 days ago; could make his presence felt in his first handicap.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Won this readily last year; struggled off 10lb higher in the Irish Cesarewitch; ended the season with a fair sixth in a big 2m handicap at Naas; strong contender despite veteran status;  Dara McGill's 7lb claim an asset, as was Alan O'Sullivan's last year.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Two from two in bumpers; gained a second win on the Flat when readily taking a 1m6f Gowran handicap in April (soft); raised 8lb for that; needs to reverse recent Faryhouse form with Tounsivator; any further easing of the ground would help.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in three maiden hurdles in recent months; unappealing on recent Flat form; unplaced favourite in a claimer last time.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Eight wins (four on Flat, four over hurdles); ended last season with a Curragh second behind Sirius; confidence dented by recent form over jumps.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Course specialist, four of his five Flat wins and both hurdle wins here; highlight when a winning favourite in this race in 2023; scored at a more modest level at last year's meeting, despite almost falling when clipping heels in the dip; rash to ignore; good point-to-point rider claims 7lb.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Best form at this venue, the scene of three of his six wins; pleasing second at Leopardstown on seasonal debut; failed to improve his weak Curragh record (now unplaced on nine visits) a month ago; highly effective over the extended mile here, this trip may stretch his stamina.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Record of six wins form 27 Flat starts; uneven form in a busy campaign since a 2m win at Dundalk in January; hard to fancy against that background.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten favourite for this race last year, never looked likely to feature, 12th of 20; needs to step up on the form of two Curragh runs this season.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Sligo for Willie Mullins in August 2024; failed to win on the Flat for that stable (no Flat win since 2022); sixth in this last year for Mullins; ran respectably at Tramore on stable debut; however, that was in a claimer; tough task here.

RaceName: Connacht Hotel (Q.R.) Handicap
Spotlight: Talented hurdler, though inferior to stablemate Daddy Long Legs (first reserve); did well to win a recent Fairyhouse conditions event on his first 2026 outing; Patrick Mullins rides, but worth noting he has partnered only one of the stable's five winners of this since 2017.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins at 5f on Southwell AW; has had some excuses this year but she put up a good show at Leicester (6f, good to firm) this month against an unexposed sprinter and this easier test at 6f can suit; should go well.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: Won over 6f at Leicester (good to soft) last September; back on the right tracks when never-nearer fourth of 11 at Thirsk (5f, good) in June but she found little at Ripon (6f; first-time visor) next time and has since left Edward Bethell for 21,000gns; too soon to rule out with headgear left off.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: Kept to 5f since late November, winning on Chelmsford AW and at Bath (good), but he kept on well when going down narrowly over 5f on this track (winner has gone in again since) in June and now looks worth another go at 6f; good claims.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: Two promising C&D runs last summer, including on good to firm, but the disappointments are mounting up and she was again beaten a long way at Newbury last month; coming down weights but has much to prove.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: One win from 18 starts, on Kempton AW (6f) in January, but he's had some excuses and is now 4lb lower than when not beaten far over C&D (good to firm) on yard debut in May; tackles these conditions for the first time since so he's entitled to be thereabouts.

RaceName: Turbo Hoofing Handicap
Spotlight: Dam has produced three very capable sprinters; this one took time to get off the mark, achieved at Ffos Las (5f; first-time cheekpieces, retained) in June, but he'd had a couple of close calls in May, the first over C&D (good to firm); should be right in this picture.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Didn't go on for Joseph O'Brien after a promising debut last summer for Jim Bolger (changed hands for 140,000gns) and was sold for just 2,500gns this month; had little chance for her new yard in a Listed race ten days ago; vulnerable.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Trainer, who boasts a good record with 3yos here down the seasons, won this 12 months ago; this filly is the pick on form but another expensive defeat last time leaves her with something to prove and she'll need to settle better than has often been the case, back up in trip minus the hood.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Went backwards for Eve Johnson Houghton last year before missing 11 months; doubtful she achieved much when second of three to an easy, short-priced winner at Thirsk recently (7f) but she's entitled to have come on for that.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to the yard's recent Group 3 winner Native Warrior and to their debut 2yo winner Cathy Come Home; wouldn't need to be anything special to take this on debut.

RaceName: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Started a big price for her Windsor debut for Martyn Meade five weeks ago and ran as anticipated, finishing a long way back after a slow start; needs to improve plenty.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Won over this trip at Dundalk and a 6.5f rated race at Limerick; seemingly improved out of all recognition when a very close second in a 6f Listed at Naas last week; up 16lb for future contests and on that basis is not easily opposable here.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Deserved success when gamely landing a 7f maiden at Limerick last month; has only raced on soft ground to date, and interesting to see how he handles a sounder surface.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Stepped up on her debut effort to win a maiden over this trip for Jarlath Fahey at Limerick in June; changed hands since then. and certainly interesting as a potentially progressive filly on her handicap debut.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Some useful maiden form last year; yet to find his form in two maiden runs this season and others preferred on his handicap debut.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in a Dundalk maiden last year for Natalia Lupini; returned from seven months off to run a fine race on his seasonal and stable debut when a luckless fourth over 6f at Fairyhouse; definite player although the draw is not ideal.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Showed a good attitude to beat Dervo Annie in a Fairyhouse handicap earlier this month; up 6lb and disappointed at Leopardstown a week later; question to answer now.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Runner-up in a Kempton maiden last year but struggled this year for Harry Charlton; bought for 20,000gns at the July sales and probably best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Fairly consistent level of form in maidens although never really came close to winning one; down 6lb to 73 after his Bellewstown maiden run last time, but even at that he might need to come down a little more.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Ran no race in the first-time visor behind Caitouna at Fairyhouse but seen to much better effect when just overhauled late at Dundalk over 7f two weeks ago; well drawn if she can get a prominent sit and one of the each-way players.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Good run on her handicap debut at Roscommon and go no run when mid-division over 6f at Fairyhouse since; plum draw for a filly likely to go forward and certainly respected.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Has come into a decent level of form on his last two starts; his recent second at Navan franked by the winner at Leopardstown subsequently; should not be far away.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Followed a good run against a much-improved rival at Down Royal by winning over 6f at Fairyhouse;  another good run at the same venue over 7f; lost a shoe at Killarney last time, but has gone up 11lb in total and will need a career best effort here.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Broke his duck in a 7f handicap at Limerick last month; not as effective off a 7lb higher mark since, and the drop of 1lb here is not guaranteed to improve her fortunes.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Little to be gleaned from three runs in maidens and well beaten on his handicap debut at Ballinrobe last week; makes little appeal.

RaceName: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
Spotlight: Ran too keen and hung right but managed to just about get home in a 7f handicap at Limerick in June; 3lb wrong here, but should get a good pace to aim at and could go well.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Two-time 6f scorer in 2025; failed to build on an encouraging reappearance Newbury fourth when eighth of ten at Ascot (6f) in May; has since undergone wind surgery, so can't be ruled out off a handy-looking mark.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Scored twice (5f/6f) on AW in 2025 and in excellent form of late since the cheekpieces went on, beaten a nose in 6f Salisbury handicap last time; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb with the headgear retained.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Posted a very good second over C&D for his new yard in May but only tenth back over C&D last month; on a long losing sequence but he's the sort to bounce back.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Yarmouth (6f) in May but he's twice failed to build on it, only seventh of 11 at Ascot (6f) 17 days ago; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: A fairly useful 5f scorer for Michael Appleby; shaped well for her new yard when placed in 5f handicaps at Wolverhampton and Nottingham in the spring but beat only one over C&D in May; freshened up since and no surprise to see her play a prominent role.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Very useful 6f AW scorer at his best; not so good nowadays but signed off for James Fanshawe with a fair third of six in 7f Wolverhampton handicap in April; more is required for new stable on a rare turf start.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: A two-time 6f scorer (including over C&D) for Paul Attwater last summer; yet to hit that form for his current handler, though, only tenth in 5f Ascot handicap last time; more is required despite a falling mark.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Landed 6f novices at Kempton and Ripon before posting an excellent fourth in York's Lowther Stakes last August; off nine months and well held on her return in 6f York handicap last month; should strip fitter here.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Scored twice at Southwell (5f/6f) in the winter and has continued in good form, staying on late when sixth of 12 in 5f Newmarket handicap 17 days ago; not out of things eased 1lb.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Enjoying an excellent season since switching to Adam Kirby and notched a third success at Lingfield (5f) in June; nearest finish after a slow start when a good fifth of 12 in 5f York handicap last time and he's a player back up in trip now.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ended a losing sequence over 5f here in June; not at his best when beating just two in 5f Ascot handicap 16 days ago but no surprise to see him bounce back returned to this track.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Completed a quick hat-trick at Haydock (6f) last spring but signed off for William Haggas with last of 13 in 6f handicap at Newcastle in November; changed hands for 7,500 guineas subsequently (also gelded) and needs to hit the ground running for new yard; tongue tied first time.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Impressive debut C&D winner last May; having first run for 12 months and only second run since when an odds-on second of eight in 6f Doncaster novice last month; travelled strongly long way there, so remains with a fair bit of potential now handicapping.

RaceName: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: In excellent form of late and ended a long losing run with a deserved fourth C&D win in eight-runner contest a week ago; very much one to consider under a 4lb penalty with Oisin Murphy again up.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Nottingham second (inclined to hang left, shouldn't be able to this time from the rail draw) has been well advertised but he didn't back it up next time and has subsequently been gelded; will need to improve off this mark.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved on his three spring efforts, having been gelded, when winning an ordinary-looking 6f Nottingham maiden nine days ago; again over-raced that day and he has more on his plate now handicapping.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Came away with two subsequent winners at Carlisle last month and ran to a similar level over C&D last time; no excuses on that latest start, having made the running from the rail draw, but she looks set to go well.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Green on his debut before showing fair form over 6f and 5.7f on his last two starts; gelded and looks on a workable mark for a trainer who won this last year (sole 2yo runner here to date); shortlisted.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Still to get involved in a finish, latterly when well held as favourite back down to 5f; gelded since and it will be interesting to see how he goes in the market now handicapping.

RaceName: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Last three runs were over 7f, latterly when not looking to see it out at Leicester on her nursery debut; the emphasis will be more on speed tonight, coming from the outside stall.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent apart from a poor Navan run on penultimate start; bounced back to win the Ulster Derby over 1m5f at Down Royal last month; stamina assured, new mark is demanding.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Built on debut Cork fourth to land a Gowran maiden over an extended 1m1f on second start, still green, quickened well off a steady pace; well beaten in a conditions race at Navan; plenty of weight here, trainer's Nod Of Approval seems more appealing.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Has turned a corner after four undistinguished runs; backed up Limerick maiden win with emphatic handicap success at the same venue; up a punitive 14lb for winning that six-runner contest.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Looked potentially smart when scoring at Navan on debut over 1m2f on heavy; beaten 6l into third by Nil Bua Gan Dua at Roscommon (winner successful again in a Listed contest at Gowran on Saturday); 7f may have been too sharp for him at Naas last time.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Promise when fifth on debut at the Curragh (1m1f, yld-sft) last September; denied by a head over 1m at Leopardstown in October; should be near peak fitness now after a run at Gowran eight weeks ago; dam won over 1m4f, trip should suit.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Has reeled off a hat-trick of 1m4f handicap wins at Cork, Leopardstown and the Curragh; further progress is feasible; however, an aggregate 19lb rise may bring the sequence to an end; not guaranteed to confirm Cork form with Nod Of Approval.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Landed a Dundalk maiden early in the year; has found life a little tougher in handicaps; out of her depth in Listed company before a fair fourth at Killarney; stable's best hope is probably Themis.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Ordinary form in three maiden runs last season; similar story on seasonal/handicap debut at Roscommon in May; battled well to win at Navan on first outing for the stable; 9lb rise may anchor him

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent in maidens; beat Vantage Code on handicap debut at Roscommon; may struggle to uphold form on 6lb worse terms.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; ran poorly when favourite for a maiden here 12 months ago; mixed signals from this year's form; second to Darius Dark at Cork in April, close fifth behind the same rival at the Curragh; no surprise if she is in the mix.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Ran twice on AW before a winning turf/handicap debut at Sligo in May (1m3f, yielding to soft); in rear at Down Royal in May; unplaced over hurdles at Killarney; questions to answer.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Towards the rear and well beaten in three maidens; failed to improve at Limerick on handicap/seasonal debut; on account of his connections, premature to write off all the same

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Some promise at two; hard to be confident after his opening handicap attempts at Leopardstown and the Curragh.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; little impact in his first two handicaps; took a step in the right direction when second to Nermal at Roscommon; bound to be fully primed for this; fair chance that this trip will prove close to his optimum.

RaceName: Gra Chocolates Handicap
Spotlight: Has not shown enough in three outings in maidens to suggest she can feature on handicap debut.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: On a losing run but she got back on track with a second of 11 in 7f Wolverhampton handicap ten days ago; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 1m winner for Andrew Balding in 2025; largely below par for current yard though, racing  freely when last of nine in 1m Ascot handicap on recent return; should strip sharper here though.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: In good form this season before finishing only sixth of eight in 1m Doncaster handicap 24 days ago; more is needed if she's to double her tally.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Fair form when in the frame in 7f Kempton maiden and 1m1f Goodwood novice in May; beat just two in 7f Southwell novice last time though so needs a big step forward now going handicapping.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Good second at Nottingham (1m) on her return but she's been well below par both runs since, tried in cheekpieces when tenth at Kempton (7f) last time; others appeal more.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Signed off for James Ferguson with an improved effort to land 1m Newmarket handicap last month; up 3lb but a player once more now starting out for yard well among the winners.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Remains winless and she came in a below-par sixth of ten in 1m Newmarket handicap last month; more is required if she's to gain a win at the eighth attempt.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: A fair sprint maiden for William Haggas; off for six months and not disgraced when fifth of ten in 1m Newbury handicap ten days ago for new yard; no forlorn hope.

RaceName: Debbie And Kieron Silver Wedding Celebration Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a first win at the eleventh attempt at Brighton (1m) in June and not disgraced under an aggressive ride when sixth at Chepstow (1m) 19 days ago; considered off a 2lb lower mark.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: French Listed win on very soft ground last autumn has left him difficult to place this season; pulling hard all three starts hasn't helped and he comes right back down in trip having been gelded since last seen a couple of months ago; has it to prove.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
Spotlight: Won his first two starts in Tapeta novices before unsurprisingly struggling to concede a double penalty to a useful winner at Doncaster; beaten a long way at Royal Ascot since and has to prove that this sort of mark is within range.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
Spotlight: A couple of short-priced defeats in early runs, not looking the easiest on his comeback, but the cheekpieces have definitely helped; won well from the front in the spring (Polytrack) and backed that up on his handicap debut last time; holds obvious claims.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
Spotlight: Plenty of racing last year and this, and has generally struggled this season; did not appear to see it out in a few runs beyond 7f and Beyond The Bar looks his trainer's best chance.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
Spotlight: £300,000 breeze-up purchase who won a small-field novice on her debut last June; not seen again until six weeks ago, when cracking late under a penalty; entitled to come on for that but needs to improve going up in trip again.

RaceName: City Of Ripon Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who bounced back to form at Catterick this month when making all off 3lb lower (7f); now needs to back it up in better company but this longer trip is fine.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; by Blue Bresil out of an unraced dam from a good family; made no impact when well fancied for an academy hurdle at Leopardstown last December; may do better now after a good break.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: 13th foal; Court Cave gelding is a brother to Grade 1 novice hurdle winner City Island, closely related to two winners; half-brother to four other winners, including the useful Fort Worth.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Remote fourth on debut at Killarney in May; considerable improvement needed.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Second foal; Poet's Word gelding is a brother to Nicky Richards-trained debut bumper winner Poet's Whisper; dam unraced sister to useful/prolific winner Hatcher (14 races); in good hands.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
OwnerName: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: Fourth foal out of the brilliant Annie Power (winner of 15 of her 17 races); Camelot gelding is brother to useful bumper/2hurdle winner Davy Crockett, half-brother to smart bumper/2m hurdle winner Mystical Power; dam won on debut here at the 2012 festival, Mystical Power won a novice hurdle here in 2023.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Second foal; dam 2m hurdle winner, sister to useful hurdle/chase winner Saint Arvans; trained by Sean Doyle when making a winning debut in a maiden point at Dromahane in April; purchased for E200,000 at Punchestown four days later; likely to make his presence felt.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Fourth foal; brother to 1m7f hurdle winner Figero, half-brother to 2m/2m4f hurdle winner Avalo; strong trainer/rider combination; others have more persuasive credentials.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Natalie Gilligan & Mark Watson & Brian J O'Higgins
Spotlight: 100-1 when down the field on debut at Killarney in May; around 10l behind fourth-placed Hill Silver; can be left out of calculations.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Made a pleasing introduction when second at the Punchestown festival; appeared to run in snatches but stuck to his task in finishing 3l second behind a Willie Mullins-trained rival; could be hard to beat with that experience under his belt.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
OwnerName: Exors of the Late Michael Moloney
Spotlight: Faded after a prominent showing at Killarney; 9-2 chance then, impossible to fancy now

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; dam unraced half-sister to high-class jumper Kalashnikov; made late progress into second behind a 33-1 chance on debut at Punchestown in the first week of June; top rider replaces a 7lb claimer; definite chance.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Twelfth foal; half-sister to several winners. notably Aussie Reigns, a Listed scorer who also won over hurdles.

RaceName: Ray Dooley Monami Construction INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; dam 2m3f hurdle winner, sister to Champion Hurdle winner Rock On Ruby and useful bumper/hurdle winner Alpine Glade; jockey's first ride.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a deserved second success of 2026 in 1m1f handicap at Nottingham six days ago, edging out Katalyst; shoulders a 6lb penalty now but this reliable sort must enter calculations.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Still to get her head in front but she failed by a short head to overhaul Takeitorleaveit in 1m1f Nottingham handicap six days ago; she needs to back it up now.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Made an encouraging start for Gemma Tutty with 1m2f Wetherby fifth but he came in last of nine at Nottingham (1m2f) 25 days ago; more needed if he's to get off the mark at the sixth attempt here.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Landed a Wolverhampton handicap (8.6f) in March and has continued in good nick, runner-up at Chepstow (1m2f) in May; not out of things after a break.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Only modest form shown in her four runs to date; went freely when a reappearance fourth of seven on her turf/handicap debut at Epsom (1m2f) 18 days ago; can build on it here in a refitted hood.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to offer much in his four outings, cheekpieces fitted when seventh of ten on handicap debut over 1m here in May; needs to take a big step forward.

RaceName: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Denis Haynes & Mrs Rebecca Smith
Spotlight: Has advanced her form since stepping into handicap company and comes here on the back of a very good third of ten at Wetherby (1m2f) last month; needs considering nudged up 1lb.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Recorded a quickfire double at Redcar and Catterick in May last year; underwent her second bout of wind surgery prior to returning this summer with below-par efforts at Thirsk and Pontefract, but back on her last winning mark so cannot dismiss.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
OwnerName: R R D Saunders And Partner
Spotlight: Has won six races and didn't shape too badly when third of nine at Catterick (5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; not out of this.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Got off the mark when scoring over C&D (good) last month; met trouble in running subsequently at Musselburgh but resumed winning ways at Beverley (5f, good to firm) 13 days ago; looks a potent force while in this class and may well go in again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at Redcar (5f, good to firm) in May off 2lb lower; has ruined her chance on latest starts by being fractious in the stalls at Beverley last month, and racing too freely at Ayr last Monday; needs to settle better.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Sole success came in a classified event last August; poor strike rate (1-22) makes her hard to fancy.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Two of his five wins have came over C&D in 2024 but has been below that form since; easy to dismiss.
